name: Csévharaszt (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Csévharaszt: a blue and white shield with a yellow castle wall and trees, within a green wreath, above a yellow scroll inscribed CSÉVHARASZT.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Csévharaszt arms with wreath and scroll
